question: Project new customer signups for January, February and March 2025 from a least-squares linear trend over the 24 monthly signup counts of 2023 and 2024, with x = 1 for January 2023 through x = 24 for December 2024. Label months as YYYY-MM.
plan: The question asks for a forecast, a projection or a fitted trend line: get the series it is fitted on (one row per period), fit it from that series, and report each forecast with its period.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH monthly_signups AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month_str, CAST(SUBSTRING(signup_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(signup_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - (2023 * 12 + 1) + 1 AS x, COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2023-01-01' AND signup_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', signup_date)), all_months_23_24 AS (SELECT 1 AS x, '2023-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2023-02' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '2023-03' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '2023-04' UNION ALL SELECT 5, '2023-05' UNION ALL SELECT 6, '2023-06' UNION ALL SELECT 7, '2023-07' UNION ALL SELECT 8, '2023-08' UNION ALL SELECT 9, '2023-09' UNION ALL SELECT 10, '2023-10' UNION ALL SELECT 11, '2023-11' UNION ALL SELECT 12, '2023-12' UNION ALL SELECT 13, '2024-01' UNION ALL SELECT 14, '2024-02' UNION ALL SELECT 15, '2024-03' UNION ALL SELECT 16, '2024-04' UNION ALL SELECT 17, '2024-05' UNION ALL SELECT 18, '2024-06' UNION ALL SELECT 19, '2024-07' UNION ALL SELECT 20, '2024-08' UNION ALL SELECT 21, '2024-09' UNION ALL SELECT 22, '2024-10' UNION ALL SELECT 23, '2024-11' UNION ALL SELECT 24, '2024-12'), stats AS (SELECT SUM(a.x) AS sum_x, SUM(COALESCE(m.signup_count, 0)) AS sum_y, SUM(a.x * a.x) AS sum_x2, SUM(a.x * COALESCE(m.signup_count, 0)) AS sum_xy, COUNT(a.x) AS n FROM all_months_23_24 AS a LEFT JOIN monthly_signups AS m ON a.x = m.x), regression AS (SELECT CAST(n AS REAL) AS n_val, sum_x, sum_y, sum_x2, sum_xy, (n_val * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n_val * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) AS slope, (sum_y - ((n_val * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n_val * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x)) * sum_x) / n_val AS intercept FROM stats), future_months AS (SELECT 25 AS x, '2025-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT 26 AS x, '2025-02' AS month UNION ALL SELECT 27 AS x, '2025-03' AS month) SELECT f.month, r.intercept + r.slope * f.x AS projected_signups FROM future_months AS f CROSS JOIN regression AS r LIMIT 500
